rationale: The target requires characterising braking behaviour itself. H-3 establishes sudden stopping without an obstacle as the hazardous event, while SG-3 and FR-7 support distinguishing unintended braking from obstacle-justified braking. P preserves the stated operational context without incorporating the sensing, computation, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” directly identifies the behaviour required to evaluate prevention of unintended braking.
“Presence or absence of an actual obstacle requiring braking” relates braking to its justification, supported by H-3 and FR-7.
“Brakes or stops unexpectedly” captures the hazardous vehicle behaviour rather than a mechanism used to prevent it.
The declared road, speed, weather, and visibility conditions match H-3's operational situation.
